title: Churro Chex Mix
description: This churro Chex mix is very easy to make and you can customize it any way you want. This version uses bone-shaped graham crackers for a Halloween look.
ingredients: 2 cups crispy rice cereal squares (such as Rice Chex™)
2 cups original flavor cone-shaped corn snacks (such as Bugles(R)), divided
2 cups cinnamon graham cracker sticks (such as bone-shaped Scooby-Doo snacks)
0.25 cup cookie butter (such as Trader Joe's® Speculoos Cookie Butter®)
5 cups cinnamon-flavored crispy rice cereal squares (such as Cinnamon Chex™)

steps.text: Combine Rice Chex, 1 cup Bugles, 1 cup graham cracker sticks, and 1/4 cup pecan halves in a large bowl.

Melt cookie butter and butter in a saucepan over medium heat. Add 1/4 cup cinnamon chips and stir until smooth and well combined. Remove from heat and pour mixture over the cereal mixture. Stir gently to coat all pieces.
Spread mixture out onto a parchment-lined baking sheet, separating any larger pieces. Allow to cool for about 15 minutes.
Combine Cinnamon Chex with remaining 1 cup Bugles, 1 cup graham cracker sticks, and 1/4 cup pecans in a large bowl. Add to the cooled mixture and toss gently to combine.
